reviews.review: I like how each stage has its own colour and the hazards are easy to see. First Steps is friendly, but 29 of 100 ghosts still die there, mostly at one spike row, which is a lot for a tutorial. Saw Mill is where I would quit: the saws float at many heights, the mid player dies, and it comes too early at stage 3. Ferry Lines, Crumble Bridge and Spring Loaded feel fair and fun. Laser Gate shows its beams clearly. Gauntlet mixes everything, but the small crumble tiles are hard to see and even the skilled player dies.
reviews.best: Spring Loaded and Crumble Bridge look fun, clear and fair, with deaths that are my own fault.
reviews.worst: Saw Mill is a difficulty spike at stage 3 with saws that are hard to read, and most players like me die there.

reviews.review: Each stage gives one mechanic its own colour and Gauntlet combines all of them, so the structure is sound. The curve is not. First Steps kills 29 of 100 ghosts at its first spike patch, which is too hard for a tutorial. Saw Mill is the hardest stage at position 3: it has many saws in the air, their paths are not shown, and the mid player dies with no warning. Spring Loaded tests saws in flight before it teaches a safe bounce. Laser Gate is the best lesson because the dotted beams show the danger early. Ferry Lines and Crumble Bridge are fair but have few hazards.
reviews.best: Laser Gate shows each beam with a dotted line before it fires, so each death is readable.
reviews.worst: Saw Mill is a difficulty spike at stage 3 with saw paths that the player cannot read.

reviews.review: I like the hazard variety and the clean, readable screens. Crumble Bridge and Laser Gate look like real routing stages: commit, keep moving, time the beam. But skill barely buys time. Ferry Lines ends at 12.3 s for everyone, so the platforms set my pace, not my hands. Spring Loaded is the same, 11.1 against 11.0. In Spike Garden the high-skill run takes 25.1 s, twice the mid run, which smells like forced waiting. Saw Mill spikes too early at 43% with floating saws that look hard to read in the air. First Steps kills 29 of 100 on its first spike row. Gauntlet is a good mixed final exam.
reviews.best: Crumble Bridge and Laser Gate reward commitment and timing with deaths that look like my own fault.
reviews.worst: Ferry Lines is a 12.3 s autoscroller for every skill level, so there is nothing to optimise.
